headline: Extortion crews cash in fresh breaches at Ernst & Young and DentaQuest while public exploits arm attackers against vBulletin, n8n, and PTC Windchill.

emerging_trends.text: Extortion crews keep converting stolen records into leverage, with ShinyHunters claiming Ernst & Young over a supply-chain intrusion and Anubis squeezing Coca-Cola's Fairlife unit.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Ernst & Young and DentaQuest Breaches Widen

emerging_trends.text: Public exploit code lands within days of disclosure, arming attackers against vBulletin forums, n8n automation servers, and Active Directory Certificate Services alike.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Public Exploits Land for vBulletin and n8n

emerging_trends.text: Attackers increasingly wear trusted software, cloning Microsoft Teams update prompts and ChatGPT billing pages to push remote-management tools and harvest credentials.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Fake Teams and ChatGPT Lures Fuel Phishing

topics.title: Ernst & Young and DentaQuest Breaches Widen
topics.latest_developments: The ShinyHunters extortion gang claimed the Ernst & Young breach on July 27, 2026, saying a supply-chain attack handed it credentials to the accounting firm's systems, as DentaQuest disclosed that a May 2026 intrusion exposed personal and dental health data on more than 23 million people.
topics.summary: Ernst & Young, the Big Four accounting firm, faces ShinyHunters extortion after intruders reached its systems through a vendor, while dental-benefits administrator DentaQuest is notifying over 23 million people whose records thieves stole. Affected customers should watch for fraud and reset any exposed credentials.

sources.title: Ernst & Young data breach claimed by ShinyHunters extortion gang
DentaQuest Data Breach Potentially Impacts Over 23 Million People

topics.title: Public Exploits Land for vBulletin and n8n
topics.latest_developments: SSD Secure Disclosure published a working exploit on July 27, 2026 for a pre-authentication remote-code-execution flaw in vBulletin 6.2.1 and earlier and 6.1.6 and earlier that routes an unauthenticated request into PHP's eval(), the same day n8n patched an expression-sandbox escape that lets an authenticated workflow editor run operating-system commands on the automation server.
topics.summary: vBulletin powers online discussion forums, and n8n is a self-hosted workflow-automation platform; both flaws hand attackers code execution on the host. Operators should upgrade immediately—vBulletin past 6.2.1 and 6.1.6, n8n to 2.31.5 or 2.32.1.

sources.title: Public Exploit Released for Patched vBulletin Pre-Auth Code Execution Flaw
n8n Sandbox Escape Lets Workflow Editors Run OS Commands as the n8n Process

topics.title: Fake Teams and ChatGPT Lures Fuel Phishing
topics.latest_developments: The Hacker News detailed Operation BlueDash on July 27, 2026, a Microsoft Teams-themed campaign that ZeroBEC found steering victims through a counterfeit Microsoft Store page to install Level RMM and ScreenConnect, as Check Point's Q2 2026 report named ChatGPT a newly impersonated phishing brand trailing Microsoft's 23% share.
topics.summary: Attackers abuse trusted brands to plant remote-management tools and steal logins, cloning Microsoft Teams update prompts and ChatGPT Plus billing pages. Employees should distrust unexpected software-update pages and verify RMM installs.

sources.title: Operation BlueDash Deploys Level RMM and ScreenConnect via Fake Teams Update
ChatGPT joins the most impersonated brands in phishing attacks

topics.title: Cell-Site Simulators and Location Data Erode Privacy
topics.latest_developments: Bruce Schneier publicized on July 27, 2026 that Israeli firm Cognyte sells its FalcoNet cell-site simulator, concealable in a van, backpack, or on-foot rig, to the state of Texas, while 404 Media detailed how broker Mike Yeagley bought phone-location data from around the world.
topics.summary: Cognyte's FalcoNet mimics a cell tower to force nearby phones to connect, letting Texas police track any device in range, and the commercial location-data trade lets brokers like Mike Yeagley buy global movement records. Both underscore how easily bystanders' phones become surveillance targets.

sources.title: Cognyte Sells a Mobile Cell Surveillance Van
This Man Bought Phone Location Data from Around the World (with Mike Yeagley)

topics.title: PTC Windchill Flaw Drives Ransomware Campaign
topics.latest_developments: SecurityWeek reported on July 27, 2026 that ransomware operators now exploit a critical unauthenticated unsafe-deserialization flaw in PTC Windchill to execute code remotely, escalating the earlier Clop data-theft extortion into full ransomware deployment.
topics.summary: PTC Windchill is product-lifecycle-management software that manufacturers run to manage engineering data, and the flaw lets unauthenticated attackers execute arbitrary code on internet-exposed servers. Administrators should patch Windchill and FlexPLM instances at once.

sources.title: PTC Windchill Vulnerability Exploited in Ransomware Campaign

topics.title: TELESHIM Hits Middle East Governments
topics.latest_developments: Zscaler ThreatLabz disclosed on July 27, 2026 that an East Asia-linked threat actor struck Middle East government entities with three previously unreported malware families—TELESHIM, MIXEDKEY, and BINDCLOAK—that abuse Telegram for command-and-control.
topics.summary: An East Asia-linked espionage actor breached government targets across the Middle East in a campaign Zscaler detected earlier this month, using Telegram-based malware to hide its command channel. Defenders should hunt for anomalous Telegram traffic and the named implants.

sources.title: TELESHIM Abuses Telegram for C2 in Attacks Against Middle East Governments

around_town.title: County Gains Court-Ordered Mental Health Treatment
around_town.latest_developments: Allegheny County courts can now order outpatient mental health treatment instead of incarceration or hospitalization.
around_town.summary: A new Allegheny County program lets courts order treatment for people in mental health crisis; from 2015 through 2022 the county evaluated more than 5,000 people a year for involuntary hospitalization and committed roughly 3,700, fewer than half of whom got follow-up outpatient care.
